sections.title: Behavior & Attacks
sections.content:
This entity is extremely dangerous. It has 3 combat phases:

1. **Phase 1 (100% - 70% HP):** Fast melee attacks and charges.
2. **Phase 2 (70% - 30% HP):** Summons 3 Celestial Minions and casts magic lightning.
3. **Phase 3 (Frenzy < 30% HP):** Gains damage resistance and increased movement speed.

sections.title: Strategy to Defeat
sections.content:
- Bring armor with **Protection IV** and **Regeneration** potions.
- Use bows with **Power V** during Phase 2 to maintain safe distance.
